init.title: Publish over MQTT
init.description: Sends today's and tomorrow's images to an MQTT broker for e-paper displays (reTerminal E1001 with epaper-home). They are only published when they change. Leave the server empty to disable.

data_description.interval: How often to check whether the image changed.
data_description.active_from: Nothing is published outside this window. No window: all day.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the broker.
error.invalid_ca: The CA certificate is not valid.
